definitions.source: Only independent audited saved derivatives; no raw reaggregation, no experiment.
definitions.partition: Purpose counts partition all-role dispatches. Existing lexical data/control/TOTAL are preserved. Snapshot export/PID are data; snapshot import is control.
definitions.output_tree_region: Actual SQL beginning WITH RECURSIVE in this fixed JDrive workflow; exact fingerprint/catalog reference retained, includes path and projected payload data.
definitions.protocol: Purpose protocol SUM is a sum of actual intervals; overlapping category sums are not a latency decomposition.
definitions.publication: Native counters retain publication meaning; no timely-hit or CPU inference.
definitions.vectors: All five matched fresh measured workflows, repeat0..4. Median category counts need not add to medianTOTAL when scheduling varies. Per-trial partitions assert exact.
